title: Migrate Dynamics NAV to Business Central online

facts.text: First upgrade from Dynamics NAV to Business Central version 14 on-premises.
Data from tables with code customizations cannot be carried forward unless converted to AL extensions.
Full migration path requires converting C/AL customizations to AL extensions and upgrading to latest version.
Reimplementation path migrates only essential business data without extension conversion beyond version 14.
Business Central online tenant and appropriate licenses required before beginning migration.
Phase 1: Assess current state, plan scope, validate prerequisites, clean data.
Phase 2: Upgrade Dynamics NAV to supported Business Central on-premises version.
